why: Lint cycle 2 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-2.md, lint-2.1, P1). Two shipped recipes paint with CSS variables that do not exist: apps/playground/src/recipes/timeline.tsx:30 (and packages/basalt-ui/docs/recipes/timeline.md:26) sets `'--bar': 'var(--vx-info-tint)'`, and recipes/two-pane.tsx:16 (two-pane.md:18) defines the amber series as `var(--vx-warning)`. Neither name is in dist or src: the tint is the Tailwind theme variable `--color-info-tint`, the status token is `--vx-warn`. `basalt-ui lint`'s token check reports both (`--vx-info-tint is not a token`, `--vx-warning is not a token. Did you mean --vx-warn?`), but the repo's gate lints the playground with oxlint alone (`lint:playground`, `packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-recipes-lint.ts`), so the token check and the stylelint preset never run over the playground. timeline.tsx:2 waives the 2.x guard's `unknown-vx-token` with the reason 'the v3 lint accepts both', which the v3 token check contradicts. An agent copying either recipe ships a bar or a series with no colour.
what: The shipped recipes use shipped tokens only, and the repo's gate runs every tool `basalt-ui lint` runs over the playground, so a token the package does not ship fails the gate.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/docs/recipes/timeline.md and two-pane.md (regenerated by gen-recipes if they are generated)
package.json scripts (the playground gate step only)
change: Replace `var(--vx-info-tint)` and `var(--vx-warning)` with the shipped names the recipe means (the info tint and `--vx-warn`), in the playground file and its recipe doc, keeping the recipe's look; if the tint has no `--vx-*` name and the recipe needs it in a custom property, use the name the token check and the class rules accept, and say which in the recipe. Drop the 2.x `theme-allow-file` line on timeline.tsx:2 for the waiver it no longer needs, and correct its reason for the one it keeps. Add a gate step in `pre` that runs the token check and the stylelint preset over apps/playground/src, the way `basalt-ui lint` runs them in a consumer (the playground's `.basalt` manifest or the engine called with the playground as the project), at 0 findings.
commits: fix: one commit in packages/basalt-ui (recipe docs, gate script), and one non-package commit (playground recipes, root package.json), in one PR.
proof: The new gate step fails on the current master recipes (paste the two findings) and passes after the change; docs/v3/cycles/lint-2/fixtures/sweep.sh reports no finding under pg-app.
acceptance: timeline and two-pane, in the playground and in their recipe docs, name only tokens the token check accepts
A gate step in `pre` runs the token check and stylelint over apps/playground/src and fails on an unknown --vx-* name (shown by reverting one line)
out_of_scope: Removing check-theme and its other waiver (v3-lint-2-wiring); the token check's nearest-name message (v3-lint-2-lint).
